# 1password

Password manager and digital vault for secure credential storage and team collaboration

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/1password/.

## Actions

- **Count Companies** (read-only): Returns the total count of companies matching the specified search criteria and filters.
- **Create Search Export Job**: Creates an asynchronous search export job for companies matching specified criteria.
- **Find Similar Companies** (read-only): Finds companies similar to a specified company based on shared attributes and characteristics.
- **Get Regions** (read-only): Returns all geographical regions available in CompanyEnrich.
- **List Bulk Enrichment Jobs** (read-only): Lists all bulk enrichment jobs for the authenticated user.
- **List group members** (read-only): List all members of a group in your Roam workspace.
- **List Roam Meetings** (read-only): Lists all meetings in your home Roam, filtered by date range.
- **List Roam Transcripts** (read-only): Lists all transcripts in your Roam workspace, filtered by date range.
- **Remove group members**: Remove one or more members from a group in your Roam workspace.
- **Search Companies** (read-only): Searches for companies based on a query string.
- **Search States** (read-only): Search states by name or country codes.
